rows.description: You promise offerings or fasts for exam, job or health outcomes. Bargaining is human and often sincere. Hold it lightly: effort and honest action still matter, and a no from heaven need not mean you were unworthy.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, gratitude, worship

rows.description: Serving in a temple, gurdwara, church, mosque or a community kitchen brings meaning. Give without seeking status, and watch for pressure to give beyond your means. Service is at its best when open to all.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: acceptance, gratitude, worship

rows.description: Someone asks for money or a lift, and you hesitate because of scams. Caution is legitimate. Offer safe help such as calling authorities or buying food, and trust your instincts without becoming hard-hearted.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, gratitude
related mind states: anger, fear, trust

rows.description: A stranger helps you at a breakdown or in an emergency. Thank them warmly, get contact if appropriate, and pass the kindness on. Such moments remind us that society runs on quiet decency.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: compassion, fear
